description: Keep a consent record for a phone number: source (where they agreed: a form URL, a checkout checkbox, a keyword they texted), consentedAt (default now), the wording they agreed to, marketing (default true), aiVoice (they agreed to calls with an AI voice). list_sms_consents reads the records back. Free. Needs Hermoso phone on (activate_phone_service) or Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).
name: record_sms_consent
title: Record SMS consent
